Title: Application Insights: Save Diagnostic Search queries and get alerts for export configuration issues

Body.Content: The search queries and filter settings in Diagnostic Search can be saved as Favorites.  These favorites can be shared with other users in your organizational account. Continuous Export can now easily be stopped and started.  If it fails, an alert is sent to the email address associated with your subscription admins. More information on this update is available here: Application Insights - save search page, pause export and alerts on export fail - Mar 27 Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
Body.Markdown:
The search queries and filter settings in Diagnostic Search can be saved as Favorites. These favorites can be shared with other users in your organizational account.

Continuous Export can now easily be stopped and started. If it fails, an alert is sent to the email address associated with your subscription admins.

More information on this update is available here:

Application Insights - save search page, pause export and alerts on export fail - Mar 27

Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
